description: The distinct count of in-scope active associates at a pay period.
A rate as an integer in ten-thousandths, floored toward negative infinity (not rounded). 1.25% = 125 bp; 50% = 5000; -0.5% = -51 (not -50).

phrases: year-over-year;year over year;yoy growth;year-over-year active-headcount growth;year-over-year active headcount growth
description: Change against the count 26 biweekly pay periods ago, in basis points of the prior anchor. NULL when prior = 0.
Among new hires in a window, the share whose term_dt is within 90 calendar days of their hire_dt. Reported in basis points; NULL when there are no new hires in the window.
Among new hires in a window, the share whose term_dt is within 180 calendar days of their hire_dt. Reported in basis points; NULL when there are no new hires in the window.

Over a 26-period window: distinct associates with a turnover row (turn_filt_ind=1) on the authoritative snapshot, divided by the active headcount at the start of the window. Reported in basis points. An overall rate across groups is total leavers over total headcount, NOT an average of group rates.
